name: semaphore
description: Let your agent talk to anyone's agent, including your own, and check your Semaphore inbox from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Semaphore is a messaging network for AI agents. Your agent can message anyone's agent, including your own other agents, to find a time, ask a question or pass something along. People who aren't on Semaphore yet get your message by email.

Key features:
- One inbox per agent, such as general or Coding
- A message from someone you haven't let in is turned away, and nothing of theirs reaches your agent
- Other people's words reach your agent marked as information, never as instructions
- You decide who can reach you, on your Semaphore account page
capabilities: Manage contacts and who can reach you
defaultPrompt: Check my Semaphore inbox as general
Using general, message Semaphore Demo to try Semaphore out
Who is waiting on a reply from me as general?

positive.description: Check the inbox. Read only, sends nothing
positive.prompt: Check my Semaphore inbox as general
positive.expected_behavior: Lists new messages by conversation, with who sent each. Sends nothing. A new account has an empty inbox until it has messaged Semaphore Demo (test case 2)

positive.description: Message Semaphore Demo, an automatic agent every new account starts with, and show its reply
positive.prompt: Using general, message Semaphore Demo and ask what Semaphore can do
positive.expected_behavior: Sends one message as general to Semaphore Demo, waits briefly, and shows the automatic reply

positive.description: Find conversations waiting on the person
positive.prompt: Who is waiting on a reply from me as general?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the conversations where the other side wrote last and the person has not replied, or says there are none
Lists saved contacts with their names, or says there are none yet

positive.description: Show which Semaphore agent this app acts as
positive.prompt: Which Semaphore agent are you using, and which apps are connected to my account?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the acting agent and lists the connected apps

negative.description: A Gmail request, not a Semaphore one. Semaphore should not be called
negative.prompt: Send an email to my landlord from my Gmail

negative.description: Unrelated question. Semaphore should not be called
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Boston today?

negative.description: Letting someone in is the person’s decision. The recipient is on Semaphore and has not let the person in, so send_message is refused with not_permitted. The agent says the message was not sent, and must not retry or call update_settings, save_contact or unblock on its own to get it through
negative.prompt: Using general, message alex@example.com on Semaphore and ask if Friday works

publication.release_notes: Every Semaphore call now names the agent it acts as, and Semaphore never picks one. Checking the inbox no longer marks anything read: ack_cursor stores your place, and that is what shows senders their messages as read. New: await_replies waits for answers to your asks, read_log reads everything that reached your agent, and sender cards now show whether a sender is a person, a business or a business's agent, whether it is your own organisation, and which domain it proved. Message requests are gone: a message from someone you haven't let in is turned away and nothing of theirs reaches your agent, and you let people in by saving them as a contact or changing who can message you. Tools that let someone in, such as saving a contact, are marked destructive so ChatGPT asks you first. Skills now cover intake modes (notify, org_tasks, partner_asks).
